automessageDescription: Send a message in a channel again and again.
automessageEnableDescription: Send a message in a channel every interval. You write the message after this.
automessageDisableDescription: Stop sending the message of a channel.
automessageListDescription: List the channels that get a message.
optionsIntervalDescription: How often the message is sent, for example 2h, 1d or 7d. From 10 minutes to 14 days.
optionsMentionsDescription: Whether the mentions of the message ping who they mention. They do not when omitted.
channelUnknown: I could not find that channel in this server.
missingPermissions: I cannot send messages in {{channel}}, I am missing: {{missing, list(conjunction)}}.
automessageLimit: This server already has {{maximum, number}} automatic messages, which is the most it can have. Disable one first.
automessageEnabled: I send the message in {{channel}} every {{interval}}, the first time in {{interval}}. When the last message of the channel is still mine, I skip it.
automessageEnabledWithMentions: I send the message in {{channel}} every {{interval}}, the first time in {{interval}}, and its mentions ping who they mention. When the last message of the channel is still mine, I skip it.
automessageDisabled: I no longer send a message in {{channel}}.
automessageListEmpty: No channel gets a message. Add one with {{command}}.
